name: flight
description: Flight — full system. Embark/charter/buy aircraft at six airfields; fly the map_world tile grid on a real-time posture tick loop through interactive takeoff/glideslope/targeting decks, OR ride an NPC-pilot charter as a passenger. Phase B hazards, no-fly airspace, cargo/passenger + smuggling contracts, ground AA + air combat, hangars, wreck salvage/rebuild, owner-only customization, and engine-noise propagation. The aircraft is a first-class object owning its occupant set; the cockpit HUD is synthesized per-aircraft.

board.note: KNOWN GAP: boards a parked aircraft row (aircraft.parked_zone_id). Aircraft are DB rows, not furniture/items/NPCs, so they can never appear in an examine Actions line — discovered via airfield look/ambience text.

buy.note: KNOWN GAP: zone-flag gate, not an examinable object.

refuel.note: KNOWN GAP: aboard an aircraft at a field with fuel stock; aircraft/zone-flag gate, not examinable.

contracts.note: KNOWN GAP: contract board is a zone flag, no board furniture.

showroom.note: Alias for `hangar` open — the 3D turntable view; surfaced via the hangar-interior room hint.

fleet.note: Full-pane 3D lazy-susan carousel of the aircraft you own at this field; own none at a dealer field and it shows the buy roster instead.

view.note: `view <tail>` opens the showroom pre-selected on one craft; generic verb, returns undefined off-field to fall through rather than hijack it.

repair.note: KNOWN GAP: owned aircraft row + zone flag airfield_id; shadows the engine gear-repair builtin and falls through when no craft.

salvage.note: KNOWN GAP: wreck aircraft row (is_wreck=1) in zone; not examinable furniture.

rebuild.note: KNOWN GAP: wreck row + zone flag airfield_id.

tune.note: KNOWN GAP: owned aircraft row + zone flag airfield_id (distinct from broadcast's tune).
